description: Versioned 9-action high-level bank aligned with the frozen LL1 command envelope. The RL action chooses vx_far and swing_clearance only. Near-goal speed, stop/slow distances, body height, enable, and yaw policy are fixed.

in_scope: bounded exploration around the audited LL1 operating region

authority_basis.vx: LL1 realized command authority established; this exact bank point remains a feasibility candidate until rollout validation
authority_basis.yaw: excluded from RL action v0; downstream deterministic/guarded heading path only
authority_basis.body_height: fixed because sustained repeatable body-height authority was not promoted
authority_basis.swing_clearance: routed/realized authority exists; no performance promotion implied
